title: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space
summary: Tomas Mikolov, Kai Chen, Greg Corrado and Jeffrey Dean submitted 'Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space' to arXiv on January 16, 2013. The paper describes two model architectures for learning continuous vector representations of words from large data sets and evaluates the resulting representations on syntactic and semantic word-similarity tasks.
significance: A documented 2013 research-paper submission milestone in neural word representation, recorded as the paper's arXiv submission date rather than an invention date, software-release date, or universal priority claim.

verification.note: The authors' arXiv record establishes the exact January 16, 2013 submission date, title, authors and abstract claims about two architectures for continuous vector representations of words. Google Research independently corroborates the same title, authors, 2013 ICLR publication identity and abstract. This candidate records only the paper-submission milestone; it does not infer a Word2Vec software release date, development start, institutional geography, ancestry, influence, causality, or a universal priority claim.
